segments.text: This is MOONKATTY NEWS. Three world stories, each checked against at least two independent sources.
The Guardian reports: Alberta voters overwhelmingly reject plan to leave Canada in referendum. CBS News reports: Voters reject separation of Alberta from Canada in referendum.

NPR reports: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja as a woman arriving from Uganda tests positive. ABC News reports: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive.
BBC News reports: UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks. The Guardian reports: UK to deploy fighter jets to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks.
These accounts come from the sources named in this edition. This edition is waiting for approval and has not been published.
